description: Change the remote config your app reads from https://{site}/app-config.json: the lowest supported and latest versions per platform (apps below the lowest must update), the update message, maintenance mode and an in-app notice. Only the fields you pass change; pass "" to clear one. Turns remote config on.

maintenance.description: true puts the app in maintenance mode.

notice_url.description: Optional https link for the notice.

site.description: Your site: its address ("habitly" for habitly.apppage.net) or id, as list_my_sites returns.

update_message.description: Shown when an update is needed.

name: set_remote_config
title: Set a site's remote config
